title: Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/catalogResources
description: A group added to an entitlement management catalog (accessPackageResource, written through accessPackageResourceRequest adminAdd / adminRemove). Found by the tuple (catalogId, originId); the GUID name is a label.

catalogId.description: Required: the catalog's object id, for example [reference('catalog').id].

originId.description: Required: the group's object id, for example [reference('group').id].

originSystem.description: AadGroup (the default, and the only origin EARM manages).

permissions.notes: Learn (entitlementmanagement-post-resourcerequests, entitlement-management-delegate, groups-concept): EntitlementManagement.ReadWrite.All is the least privileged permission (application callers also need Group.ReadWrite.All). The caller must be a catalog owner or Identity Governance Administrator AND an owner of the group or hold a role that changes its members. A role-assignable group can only be added by a Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator (or an owner of the group); an application then needs RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory instead of Group.ReadWrite.All. Without them Graph answers 403 (CatalogResourceAccessDenied). rolesAllOf: the roles are needed together (a catalog owner role AND a role that changes the group); the permission manifest narrows the second part to Privileged Role Administrator for a role-assignable template group and drops it for any other template group.
